reason: The potato stems need room, and the cargo mesh and tool might make a support for them.
expectation: I expect to prepare some kind of plant support, though I don't know exactly what it will make.

alternatives.reason: The lettuce is ready to harvest, but I want to address the stated potato goal first.

effect: The mesh and tool made a plant support cage, so I can now fit it to the potato trough.
reaction: That was a straightforward and satisfying preparation.
reason: The cage looks suited to giving the potato stems room and support as they grow.
expectation: I expect to install the cage on the potato trough and make progress on the stated goal.

alternatives.reason: The lettuce is ready to harvest, but I want to finish setting up the potato support first.

effect: The cage completed the potato support goal, and the new goal shifts my attention to harvesting the lettuce.
reaction: The image of leaves spreading above tubers still to come makes the wait feel tangible.
reason: Harvesting the ready lettuce is the only offered combination and fits the new goal.
expectation: I expect the scissors to yield harvested lettuce, though it may need another step before tasting.

effect: The scissors produced fresh lettuce leaves, which can now be taken to the galley for the tasting goal.
reaction: Harvesting was straightforward; I’m curious what the first taste will be like.
reason: Using the leaves at the galley is the only offered combination and seems like the next step toward tasting them.
expectation: I expect to prepare or taste the lettuce at the galley, though I’m not sure whether another step will be needed.

effect: The lettuce became a fresh meal, completing the harvest goal and the chapter.
reaction: The green smell against the barren view makes the harvest feel tangible.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making the first fresh meal was the most worthwhile moment: the sensory detail made the long growing effort feel real.

leastWorthwhile.text: Cutting the lettuce was a predictable, straightforward step, though it fit the harvest.

surprise.text: The contrast between the green meal and the colorless landscape made the harvest feel more significant than I expected.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary; the cage supported the potatoes and the scissors and galley served the harvest.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the potatoes develop and what happens next, though this chapter's combinations were straightforward.
